objectives.check: Did the learner agree on a concrete, measurable requirement?

prep_chunks: Could you clarify what you mean by…?

title_vi: Giải thích một bug cho khách
title_en: Explain a bug to a non-tech client
scenario_vi: Một tính năng bị lỗi. Giải thích cho khách hàng không rành kỹ thuật: chuyện gì xảy ra, ảnh hưởng gì, khi nào sửa xong.

ai_persona.name: Mrs. Chen
ai_persona.personality: Hơi lo lắng, cần trấn an

objectives.text_vi: Giải thích lỗi bằng ngôn ngữ đơn giản
objectives.check: Did the learner explain the issue simply, avoiding jargon?

objectives.text_vi: Nói rõ ảnh hưởng tới khách
objectives.check: Did the learner explain the impact on the client?

objectives.text_vi: Cho biết thời gian khắc phục
objectives.check: Did the learner give an ETA or next step?

offline_script.persona: Why can't I see my reports?
offline_script.sample: What happened is the report service was down for an hour. It doesn't affect your data.

offline_script.persona: Is my data safe?
offline_script.sample: Yes, your data is safe. Only the display was affected.

offline_script.persona: When will it be back?
offline_script.sample: We'll have it fixed by 3 PM and I'll keep you updated.

scenario_vi: Demo tính năng mới cho khách trong 3 phút. Giới thiệu, chỉ cách dùng, nêu lợi ích.

objectives.text_vi: Giới thiệu tính năng trong 1 câu
objectives.check: Did the learner introduce the feature clearly?
Did the learner walk through how to use it?
Did the learner state the benefit for the client?

offline_script.persona: So what are you showing me today?
offline_script.sample: Let me show you the new dashboard. It gives you a quick view of all projects.

offline_script.persona: How do I use it?
offline_script.sample: First, you click on the project. Then you can filter by status.

offline_script.persona: Why is this useful?
offline_script.sample: The benefit is you save time and see problems early.

scenario_vi: Khách muốn thêm tính năng gấp trước deadline. Bạn cần phản đối lịch sự và đề xuất giải pháp thay thế.

objectives.text_vi: Ghi nhận ý kiến khách trước
objectives.check: Did the learner acknowledge the client's point first?
Did the learner disagree with a reason?

objectives.text_vi: Đề xuất giải pháp thay thế
objectives.check: Did the learner propose an alternative?

prep_chunks: I'm not sure that's the best option because…

offline_script.persona: I want the chat feature added before Friday.
offline_script.sample: I see your point, but adding chat now would affect the timeline.

offline_script.persona: The client really wants it.
offline_script.sample: I understand, however it needs at least a week. Could we phase it after launch?

offline_script.persona: Okay, what do you suggest?
offline_script.sample: How about we deliver the core first and add chat next sprint?

scenario_vi: Trò chuyện nhẹ nhàng 2 phút trước khi vào họp: thời tiết, cuối tuần, cà phê.

Did the learner share something about themselves?

offline_script.persona: Hey! How's it going?
offline_script.sample: Pretty good, thanks! How was your weekend?

offline_script.persona: It was nice, I went hiking. You?
offline_script.sample: Lovely! I just relaxed at home and watched a movie.

offline_script.persona: Sounds fun. Ready for the meeting?
offline_script.sample: Almost! Let me grab a coffee first.

Did the learner highlight key skills?

Did the learner confirm the directions?
Did the learner thank the person?

scenario_vi: Bạn phát hiện task sẽ trễ 2 ngày so với cam kết. Báo cho PM (người Anh) một cách trung thực, kèm lý do và phương án khắc phục.

ai_persona.name: Sarah
ai_persona.personality: Điềm tĩnh, coi trọng dữ liệu

objectives.text_vi: Nêu rõ task nào sẽ trễ
objectives.check: Did the learner state which task will slip?
Did the learner explain the cause?
Did the learner propose a recovery plan?

prep_chunks: The task will be delayed by…

offline_script.persona: Which task is at risk?

offline_script.persona: What caused it?

offline_script.persona: How do you propose to recover?

scenario_vi: Bạn là BA chạy workshop với khách hàng (người Úc) để chốt yêu cầu cho một tính năng mới. Đặt câu hỏi làm rõ và tóm tắt lại.

objectives.check: Did the learner ask clarifying questions?
Did the learner confirm requirements?
Did the learner summarise the outcome?

offline_script.persona: Could you clarify what 'fast' means here?
offline_script.sample: It should respond within two seconds.

offline_script.persona: Just to confirm, you need export to CSV?
Let me summarise the requirements.

scenario_vi: Bạn review pull request của đồng nghiệp (người Mỹ). Nêu nhận xét lịch sự, chỉ ra vấn đề và đề xuất cải thiện.

objectives.check: Did the learner give polite feedback?
Did the learner point out the issue?
Did the learner suggest an improvement?

offline_script.persona: Thanks for the PR! One thing I noticed…
Could we consider handling the null case?
What do you think about adding a test?

scenario_vi: Bạn gọi cho khách hàng tiềm năng (người Anh) để giới thiệu dịch vụ. Xử lý từ chối lịch sự và chốt bước tiếp theo.

objectives.check: Did the learner pitch concisely?
Did the learner handle the objection?
Did the learner agree a next step?

offline_script.persona: I'm calling about our automation service.
I understand, but could I show you a quick comparison?
Shall we schedule a 15-minute demo?

scenario_vi: Bạn tham gia họp retrospective cuối sprint (facilitator người New Zealand). Chia sẻ điều tốt/chưa tốt và đề xuất cải tiến.

objectives.check: Did the learner mention what went well?
Did the learner mention what went wrong?
Did the learner propose an improvement?

offline_script.persona: What was challenging?
Any improvement ideas?
offline_script.sample: Maybe we could set a review SLA.

objectives.check: Did the learner explain the overview?
Did the learner describe the main flow?
Did the learner mention caveats?

The flow starts at the login handler.
Watch out for the token refresh logic.

objectives.check: Did the learner introduce the team?
Did the learner mention the tools?
Did the learner explain the schedule?

prep_chunks: Let me know if you need…

objectives.check: Did the learner decline politely?
Did the learner propose a trade-off?
Did the learner confirm the agreement?

objectives.check: Did the learner describe the bug?
Did the learner assess severity?
Did the learner assign an owner?

objectives.check: Did the learner give a concise update?

Did the learner suggest cross-support?

offline_script.sample: Today I'm focusing on the dashboard.

objectives.check: Did the learner state the problem?
Did the learner present the solution?
Did the learner quantify the benefit?

objectives.check: Did the learner introduce themselves?
Did the learner describe experience?
Did the learner explain motivation?

prep_chunks: I'm interested in this role because…
